caption: The drawing features three metallic utensils rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a light, off-white background. At the top, there is a slender, curved implement with a narrow, elongated form and a slight hook at the end. Below that, there are two similar flat utensils displayed horizontally, with the bowl of each facing to the right and the handles to the left. The second utensil from the top has a rectangular handle with the text "PATENTED" inscribed on it, and a shallow, wide bowl. The utensil at the bottom has a matching handle shape, inscribed with the text "Adams," and a similarly shaped bowl. Below these two utensils, on the white space of the background, the name "F. Hastings" is written in a small, cursive script. The entire composition is centered on the page, with the utensils rendered in shades of grey, giving the appearance of polished metal. The background shows some faint spots and marks, but is otherwise plain.
title: Silver Salt Spoon
